Company in Roeselare

Jobomschrijving

What does the role involve?

• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.

• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key.

Profile – What do we expect from you?

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to KnowYou’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

jobs.occupation: Operator Automotive | Protection & Finishing of New Vehicles
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities

 
• Clean and prepare vehicles before treatment
 
• Mask components that should not be coated
 
• Apply protective coatings using professional spraying equipment
 
• Perform quality checks on finished vehicles
 
• Report any irregularities or defects
 
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

Who Are We Looking For?

 
• You enjoy physical and hands-on work
 
• You have an eye for detail and take pride in delivering quality work
 
• You communicate fluently in either English or Dutch
 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence and are comfortable driving both manual and automatic vehicles
 
• You are reliable, eager to learn, and enjoy working as part of a team
 
• Experience in automotive, production, vehicle maintenance, bodywork, or spray painting is an advantage, but not required

The role

• You will join the Business Process Team and shape how network operations work.
• End-to-end processes that drive network transformation and automation are yours to design, improve and govern.
• Business stakeholders, operational teams and technical teams find their connection in you, as you translate business needs into clear processes, requirements and functional specifications.
• Using the BPMN 2.0 standard, you model AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
• KPIs help you monitor process performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, automation and customer experience.
• Your scope covers the network lifecycle, from planning and rollout to activation, service assurance, maintenance and sometimes phase-out.
• Complex challenges become clear, effective processes that support efficient, scalable and future-ready telecom operations.

Desired profile

• Experience in process management, continuous improvement or business analysis, preferably in telecommunications
• Experience managing cross-functional projects, including adoption and organizational change
• The following are an asset:
• hands-on experience with BPMN 2.0 and ARIS or a comparable modelling tool
• good knowledge of telecom networks, or the curiosity and drive to quickly build and apply this knowledge
💡 Your skills

• Business needs are something you gather, challenge and translate into process and functional requirements.
• Workshops, interviews, process reviews and gap analyses are familiar ground, and you facilitate them with ease.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills help you move topics forward.
• Operational teams, tool owners, and process and IT architects all find in you a good partner to work with.
• Strong communication in Dutch and/or French is combined with a working knowledge of English.
🌟 Who are you?

• Autonomous and assertive, with natural leadership
• A strong communicator with a customer-oriented mindset
• Flexible, both in business and technical matters
• Rigorous in your approach

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Copper Phase Out - Telecom
jobs.description:
The offer

• As a Project Manager you will join the Copper Phase-Out team and help accelerate the migration of customers from copper-based services to fibre.
• Customer migrations are yours to coordinate, with a strong focus on operational efficiency and customer continuity, action plans stay on track because you follow up on deadlines and dependencies.
• Together with the cross-functional teams, you validate migration paths and ensure their feasibility, internal stakeholders rely on you to support decision-making, resolve issues and keep departments aligned.
• Regular reports show the migration status and blockers, so progress remains visible.
• Compacting programmes also fall within your scope, as you support the consolidation of network sites or equipment.

• Equipment migration initiatives linked to modernisation, simplification or decommissioning plans benefit from your support.
• With the engineering and operational teams, you align actions related to network upgrades and resource optimisation.

Desired profile

• Full professional proficiency in French, Dutch and English, both spoken and written
• Good understanding of, or willingness to learn, telecom platforms, customer access technologies and provisioning flows
• The following are an asset:
• experience in telecom operations, service provisioning or network migration
• previous involvement in cross-functional or transformation projects
💡 Your skills

• Complex technical cases don't put you off: you analyse them and propose migration solutions.
• New internal tools and systems for migration and network transformation are quickly mastered.
• Strong communication and coordination skills help you collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
• Your organisational skills allow you to manage diverse topics simultaneously.
🌟 Who are you?

• A problem solver with a proactive attitude, who takes ownership of actions
• Customer-oriented, structured and reliable

jobs.occupation: Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer | Pharma | Beerse
jobs.description:
As a Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer, you are responsible for preparing, maintaining and executing qualification documentation for GMP-critical equipment, utilities and systems. You ensure that all documentation complies with applicable GMP requirements and internal quality standards. You work closely with C&Q Leads, Subject Matter Experts and project teams to support qualification projects from initiation through completion. Besides document preparation, you also participate in qualification testing and follow-up activities. Your work plays an important role in ensuring that systems remain in a validated and compliant state.
Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Writing qualification documentation including URS, SRS, IA, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, QSR and Validation Master Plans
 
• Executing and documenting qualification tests for equipment, utilities and systems
 
• Assessing the impact of changes, deviations and discrepancies on qualification activities
 
• Coordinating document reviews, approval flows and signature processes
 
• Following up punch list items and qualification actions until closure
 
• Supporting internal and external audits and inspections
 
• Managing document archiving in accordance with GMP and GDP requirements

You are structured, quality-minded and eager to learn. You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and enjoy working in a team-oriented GMP environment. At the same time, you are capable of independently managing documentation and qualification activities.

What you bring

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or technical field such as Industrial Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
 
• Strong interest in the pharmaceutical industry and GMP-regulated environments
 
• Excellent technical writing and documentation skills
 
• Experience with engineering systems, utilities or manufacturing equipment is an asset
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

jobs.occupation: Operator with Forklift Experience | 2-Shift System | Food Industry
jobs.description:
 Do you have forklift experience and enjoy working in a production environment? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you.

For a growing food production company in the Diksmuide area, Konvert is looking for a Packaging Operator with forklift experience. In this varied role, you combine machine operation with internal logistics, making you an essential part of the production process.

Your responsibilities:

 
• Operate and monitor packaging machines.
 
• Perform quality checks on finished products.
 
• Supply packaging materials using a forklift.
 
• Transport finished goods safely within the warehouse and production area.
 
• Assist with minor machine adjustments and keep the process running smoothly.

✔ Experience operating a forklift (certificate is a plus)

✔ Technical insight and a hands-on attitude

✔ Comfortable working in a cold environment

✔ Flexible during busy production periods

✔ Good communication skills in Dutch, English, or French

Department of Biomedical Sciences – Trypanosoma Unit 
 

For a more detailed research context, please refer to the PDF document.
 

Your role:
 

 · Develop an innovative and internationally competitive research programme on trypanosomes, with a strong foundation in fundamental parasite biology and/or host–parasite–vector interactions.
 

· Develop, apply and disseminate state-of-the-art experimental approaches in fundamental research, which may include advanced molecular biology, biochemistry, imaging, cell biology, multi-omics and/or computational methods, according to the candidate’s expertise and research interest.
 

· Be willing to take responsibility for and further develop the unit’s existing translational and applied research portfolio, including its contribution to HAT diagnosis, molecular surveillance and control programmes, as well as the scientific use and maintenance of its tsetse fly facility.
 

· Establish and foster strong global partnerships and collaborations.
 

· Acquire competitive research funding and build up international reputation and visibility.
 

· Contribute actively to the development and delivery of the educational portfolio of the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM, including supervision of Master students and PhD training.
 

· Build and lead a team of scientific and technical staff, take up management responsibilities appropriate to the academic level.
 

· Collaborate with other units in the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM to develop complementary research lines on vector-borne and protozoan diseases.
 

· Contribute expertise to national and international bodies and stakeholders, where relevant to the candidate’s field.
 

· Oversee and direct ITM’s WHO Collaborating Centre for Research and Training on Human African Trypanosomiasis Diagnostics.
 

· Promote and contribute to the strategic vision of the department and to relevant ITM committees.

Profile / Requirements
 

· A PhD degree in biology, veterinary sciences, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, medicine, or equivalent field. 
 

· An excellent research profile in experimental/molecular parasitology of Trypanosomatids. 
 

· Experience with advanced experimental and/or computational approaches relevant to the proposed research programme. 
 

· A proven track record of successful grant writing and project supervision, in accordance with the candidate’s career stage. 
 

· A collaborative scientific profile and ability to develop interdisciplinary and international collaborations. 
 

· Experience in translational or applied research, capacity strengthening, and collaboration with institutions in endemic countries is considered an asset. 
 

· Prior experience in running a tsetse fly facility is not essential, though an interest in helping to run and utilize the tsetse facilities is considered an asset. 
 

· Experience in academic teaching and training in the field of parasitology is highly valued. 
 

· Excellent communication skills and respectful people management skills. 
 

· Fluent in English. Knowledge of French is an asset. Active knowledge of Dutch is desirable. If you do not have these skills, willingness to acquire a working level of Dutch is requested. 
 

· You support the mission and values of the ITM.
